purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0027 in the relativity arena: quadrature from the lazy root token's self ports (a STAND-IN), pass: the band eigenvector's weight on the ports that copy nowhere is exactly (1 - 24/Q) cos(mu) tan((mu + E)/2) / sin(E); at the light mass its excess over the massless half, normalized at rest, is mu / E, so $x^2$ + (v/c0)^2 = 1 to 1.04e-3 at D = 2 to 6 over 13 directions (spread 7.6e-7), not linear (miss 0.41) and not $\mu ^2 / E^2$ (miss 0.35); at the coin's own phase mu = pi/3 the self share rises with speed (to 1.049 of rest) and the quadrature misses by 6.5 to 28 percent; the whole-copy token has no self port at all.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
